status_note: Contains 18 passing local tests, including fixture API/auth/audit, MFA fallback, recovery-code, replay, challenge lockout/expiry and authenticator revocation coverage, plus the Vite proxy smoke. TOTP is a compatibility fallback only; WebAuthn/passkeys, verified-contact notification delivery, external production key management, browser-rendered accessibility, live provider, PostgreSQL/Redis, and production deployment remain unverified.
